mapper.select: INSERT INTO harvest_run (adapter, window_from, window_to) VALUES (#{adapter}, #{from}, #{to}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE harvest_run SET calls = calls + #{calls}, works_seen = works_seen + #{seen}, works_new = works_new + #{created}, state = CASE WHEN state IN ('DEFERRED','FAILED') THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE state END, finished = CASE WHEN state IN ('DEFERRED','FAILED') THEN NULL ELSE finished END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE harvest_run SET error = COALESCE(error, #{error}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT max(window_to) FROM harvest_run WHERE adapter = #{adapter} AND state <> 'FAILED'
SELECT max(window_to) FROM harvest_run WHERE adapter = #{adapter} AND state = 'DONE'
SELECT * FROM harvest_run ORDER BY started DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
